dict.string: Always double jump to get over the red hurdles.
Try jumping over one hurdle, then double jump without landing to get over the next hurdle.
Try sprinting through the sand pits.
Press the action button to cheer and gain one health.
Press the action button in front of other people to gain two health.
Try double jumping early to get over the pigs.
Press the action button to kick the chickens and gain one health.
Don't kick the stone chickens.
Kicked chickens are the best way to defeat cows.
Don't double-jump when you see a crow.
Press the action button to cheer and gain one health.
Press the action button in front of other people to gain two health.
Press the action button to shuffle past the dancers and get one health.
Try jumping over the redhead instead of dancing with her.
The blonde dancer will slow you down. Try running past her.
Press the action button to cheer and gain health.
Sprint to get enough speed to get over the long pits.
Press the action button in front of other people to gain two health.
Use the ledges to jump over the hearts and brains.
Shoot the zombies to gain one health.
Sprint to get enough speed to get over the long pits.
Press the action button to block the ship's attacks.
Blocking the ship's attacks will give you health.
Press the action button to blow out the fire demons and gain one health.
Utilize the ledges to complete the level.
Try sprinting when going against the rock lava enemy.
Blow the fire off the foxes to jump over them easier and also to gain one health.
Press the action button to cheer and gain one health.
Press the action button in front of other people to gain two health.
Don't jump when you see the umbrella.
Try sprinting against the wind.
You can jump as much as you want in this level.
Press and hold the action button to dive down faster after jumping.
Use the action button to pop the bubbles for one or two health.
Sprint on the ground to speed up to get faster times.
Press the action button to detonate any bombs you see to gain one health.
A well timed sprint will help you get past the bats.
Jump on the minecarts to help get past the spikes.
Press the action button to pump weights and gain one health.
Press the action button in front of the trainers to gain two health.
Be aware of the direction the treadmills are going before using them.
Punch the ninjas to gain one health.
You can jump again in the air. This will help you get over enemies or pits.
The battery shows how much health you have left.
Press the sprint button to run faster. Then you can press it again to slow back down.
Double jumping slows you down. Use sparingly when going for faster times.
If you are speed bursting you can use a smaller jump to get over some enemies.
Remember, tap for small jump, hold for medium jump.
Completing an action successfully gains health.
